body.summary: A unified customer support platform that solves the problem of fragmented communication channels. The story follows "Sarah", a support agent juggling phone calls, SMS, emails, and chat across different systems. Patanisha consolidates all conversations into vCon-structured records, giving agents a complete customer interaction history.
